name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Account Management | SaaS Implementation, Technical Advocacy & Adoption | REST APIs, Web Technologies
summary: Technical account manager and implementation lead with 15+ years in SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments. Owns the customer relationship end to end: learns the business, maps it to the platform, guides architecture and setup, and advocates for the customer with Product and Engineering. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%), led onboarding teams of up to 30 at Wix while launching 25+ clients a month, and advised executives at Accelo on operational system design. Hands-on with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, JavaScript and Python, HTML/CSS, CMS platforms, and schema markup, and turns complex technical detail into frameworks non-technical stakeholders can act on.

Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts and write proposals and statements of work for expanded engagements.
